title: Append Text to a File
question: Create a file with one line, append a second line, then print the complete file contents.
code:
with open("notes.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write("First line\n")

with open("notes.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write("Second line\n")

with open("notes.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    print(file.read(), end="")
explanation: Write mode replaces file contents, append mode adds to the end, and read mode retrieves the contents.
